description: A dark-haired man with a moustache, in a loose white shirt with rolled sleeves and a dark leather apron, swings an axe into the curved wooden hull of a ship in a busy shipyard. Tall-masted ships, other workers, wood shavings, mallets and a rope-strewn floor fill the background and foreground. It is a dark, painterly oil style with no visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
